name: social-network
description: Credible social/community web product archetype. Defaults to a usable MVP rather than a feed-only demo.

core: user profiles with editable display name, username, bio and avatar
expected: pagination or bounded incremental feed loading
empty, loading, validation and error states

journeys: discover user -> follow -> see their posts in feed
create post -> optionally upload media -> publish -> view post detail
guidelines: Do not declare a social-network app complete after creating only authentication and a basic post list.
Media storage must be durable across container restarts; development may use a named Docker volume.
Enforce ownership checks on profile edits, post deletion, and uploaded media changes.
Prefer a coherent visual system and reusable post/profile components over isolated HTML pages.
definition_of_done: A new user can register, log in, edit a profile and upload an avatar.
An authenticated user can create a text post and an image post.
The feed renders posts with author, timestamp, media, like state and comment affordance.
Users can follow/unfollow, like/unlike and comment with persisted state.
Search/discovery and notifications exist unless explicitly deferred by the user.
Primary pages have responsive layout plus empty/error/validation states.
Uploaded files reject unsupported types and excessive sizes.
Application data and uploads survive normal Docker restart/down-up cycles.
Health endpoint returns success after the application is actually usable.
